about.title: About us
about.subtitle: Seventh Day Adventist Reform Movement in Germany & Austria
about.fallbackText1: sdarm.life is the local online presence of the Seventh Day Adventist Reform Movement in Germany — part of the worldwide community at sdarm.org.
about.fallbackText2: Our community was founded as a place of spiritual renewal — for people who take biblical truth, the Sabbath, and the message of the Reformation seriously.
about.glaubensSub: 25 principles that shape our thinking and living.
about.metaTitle: About Us – Seventh Day Adventist Reform Movement
about.metaDescription: Meet the Seventh Day Adventist Reform Movement – 25 principles of faith, Sabbath observance, the Reformation message and Bible-based Christianity in Germany & Austria.

uberUns.title: About us
uberUns.faithText: We believe in the complete authority of the Holy Scriptures as the foundation of all doctrine and life. The Bible is our only standard for faith and practice — unchanging and timeless.
uberUns.sabbathText: We observe the biblical Sabbath — the seventh day of the week — as a holy day of rest, as God established at Creation and commanded in the Ten Commandments.
uberUns.communityText: As a reform movement within Adventism, we are committed to a complete return to the principles of the Bible — in doctrine, lifestyle, and worship.
uberUns.worshipText: At the center of our lives is the worship of God — in spirit and in truth, following the example of the Holy Scriptures and the early Christian church.
uberUns.healthText: We cultivate a lifestyle that honours the body as the temple of God — natural nutrition, exercise, and temperance as part of holistic Christian living.
uberUns.prophecyText: Biblical prophecies guide our community. We live in expectation of Christ's soon return and prepare ourselves and others for it.
uberUns.prayerText: Personal prayer and daily Bible study are the cornerstones of our spiritual life. In stillness we encounter the living God.

datenschutz.title: Privacy Policy
datenschutz.section1Body:
Community of Seventh Day Adventist Reform Movement e. V.
Eisenbahnstr. 6, D-65439 Flörsheim/M
datenschutz.section2Body: When you subscribe to our newsletter, we store your email address and the time of registration. Processing is based on your consent pursuant to Art. 6(1)(a) GDPR. You may revoke your subscription at any time using the unsubscribe link in each newsletter email.
datenschutz.section3Body: This website does not set its own cookies. Cloudflare, as a technical service provider, may set a functionally necessary cookie (__cf_bm) for protection against automated access. This cookie does not require consent (Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR).
datenschutz.section3LocalStorage: The book reader stores reading preferences (theme, font size, typeface, line spacing) in the browser's local storage (localStorage). This data remains solely on your device, is not transmitted to any server, and contains no personal data. The storage serves exclusively for user convenience and does not require consent (§ 25(2)(2) TTDSG). You can delete these settings at any time via your browser settings.
datenschutz.section4Body: This website is hosted via Cloudflare Pages. Cloudflare may process technical access data (e.g. IP address, time of access). Website statistics are collected via Cloudflare Web Analytics — cookie-free, without user profiles and without personal data.
datenschutz.section5Body: The “Treasures” platform allows digital books in EPUB format to be read directly in the browser. When opening a book, your browser establishes a direct connection to the external file server (currently: egwwritings.org, operated by the Ellen G. White Estate, Inc., USA) from which the EPUB file is retrieved. In doing so, your IP address and the time of access are transmitted to this third-party provider.
